remarks: Fully Furnished Seasonal Rental in Westport - Fall 2025 through Spring 2026  Fully furnished contemporary home located on a quiet cul-de-sac, minutes from downtown Westport, beaches, and restaurants. Offering 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and 4,711 sq ft of living space, this home features an open floor plan with high ceilings, oversized windows, and a double-sided brick fireplace.  The property includes a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, gas range, and heated wood floors, a formal dining room, two living areas, and a welcoming foyer with a piano. The lower level offers a recreation room with ping pong, toys, books, and fitness equipment, while the primary suite features a soaking tub, heated floors, and a walk-in closet. Additional amenities include central air, an attached two-car garage, public utilities, a porch, deck, gas grill, outdoor seating, and a full-house automatic backup generator.  Close to Sherwood Island State Park, golf courses, tennis courts, and town amenities. Available for Fall, Winter, and Early Spring 2025-2026 with flexible lease dates. Liability/renter's insurance with a minimum of $500,000 coverage required.
